parts.text: Edit this image: the vest pins have duplicates. Remove exactly three pins so each design appears only ONCE: remove the LEFT one of the two orange flame pins, remove the lower knife pin (the one below the green vial, beside the heart), and remove the SMALL red blood drop pin (keep the larger blood drop). Fill the gaps with plain olive vest fabric. That leaves exactly 8 pins: skull, flame, knife, axe, green vial, eyeball, heart, blood drop. Keep everything else exactly the same.
